philippines.title: Bangs Garcia becomes dual citizen of the Philippines, United Kingdom
philippines.description:
Former actress Bangs Garcia has officially reacquired her Philippine citizenship, making her a dual citizen of the Philippines and the United Kingdom. Garcia announced the milestone through Instagram on Wednesday, July 15, sharing a photo of herself holding her certificate in front of a Philippine flag. “Dual citizenship: unlocked today! Officially Filipino (again) & British!” she captioned the post. The update comes two years after Garcia revealed that she had become a British citizen. In July 2024, the actress said she had officially pledged allegiance to King Charles III and the United Kingdom, seven years after marrying her British husband, […]...
